headline: Sri Narsingh Infrastructure discloses substantial shareholding in Baazar Style Retail under SEBI takeover rules
sum: Sri Narsingh Infrastructure Private Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Baazar Style Retail Limited. The filing represents compliance with mandatory SEBI takeover disclosure requirements for shareholding movements crossing statutory thresholds.
detail: Sri Narsingh Infrastructure Private Limited has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, to the National Stock Exchange. This disclosure is a mandatory filing whenever an acquirer's shareholding reaches or crosses the 5% threshold in a listed company. The specific acquisition details—including share quantity, price, percentage holding, and acquisition mode—are contained in the full disclosure document filed with NSE on or around 29 June 2026.
